name: ledgerlight v1 stage 3: design, app shell, live dashboard, UI bus

Run `bash scripts/check.sh` yourself. Check every Build item is done and tested, SKILL.md is complete, schema migration is safe on the previous stage DB, CLI/API/other entry points share one function per behavior, no secrets or real data.
